Placemaker.Roads.Name: Roads
Placemaker.Roads.Control.pattern.Tooltip: How the streets are laid out inside the area.
Placemaker.Roads.Option.pattern.grid.Too: Straight streets in a regular grid, aligned with the longest side of the area.
Placemaker.Roads.Option.pattern.tree.Too: A collector along the area with branches ending in pairs of cul-de-sacs.
Winding streets with cul-de-sacs and a few loops, like a suburban subdivision.
Streets follow the terrain's contour lines, linked by gentle uphill roads. Needs sloped terrain.
Placemaker.Roads.Option.pattern.mixed.To: A radial centre with a roundabout, surrounded by organic streets.
Placemaker.Roads.Option.pattern.loop.Too: Widely spaced collectors with a looping local street inside each large block.
Placemaker.Roads.Option.pattern.superblo: Collectors around groups of 3 × 3 blocks with car-free streets inside.
Placemaker.Roads.Option.pattern.concentr: Rings that follow the shape of the area, joined by connecting streets.
Placemaker.Roads.Option.pattern.radial.T: A central roundabout with straight avenues out to the edge, optionally crossed by circular rings.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.roadMix.Tooltip: Which road goes where, in one pick. It sets the street, avenue, local, roundabout and perimeter roads and their upgrades below; changing any of them makes it Custom.
Placemaker.Roads.Option.roadMix.auto.Too: The standard mix: Two-Lane Roads for streets, Four-Lane Roads for avenues, a Two-Lane One-Way Road around roundabouts.
Placemaker.Roads.Option.roadMix.quiet.To: Two-Lane Roads everywhere, even the avenues, with street trees and grass verges. Calm streets for houses.
Placemaker.Roads.Option.roadMix.alleys.T: Narrow two-way Alleys between the blocks; Two-Lane Roads for the avenues and the edge.
Placemaker.Roads.Option.roadMix.pedestri: Pedestrian Streets inside (service vehicles only); cars stay on the Two-Lane avenues and the perimeter road.
Placemaker.Roads.Option.roadMix.boulevar: Tree-lined Two-Lane streets and divided Four-Lane avenues with trees in the median.
Streets: Two-Lane + trees · Avenues: Four-Lane Divided + median trees
Placemaker.Roads.Option.roadMix.downtown: A busy core: Four-Lane streets, Six-Lane avenues and three-lane one-way roundabout rings.
Placemaker.Roads.Option.roadMix.bike.Too: The standard mix with bike lanes on every street and avenue.
Placemaker.Roads.Option.roadMix.bike.Det: Streets: Two-Lane + bike lanes · Avenues: Four-Lane + bike lanes
Gravel Roads for villages and farmland; a Two-Lane Road for the through routes and the edge.
Placemaker.Roads.Option.roadMix.custom.T: Your own picks: choose each road below.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.streetAsset.Too: The road for ordinary streets (and the perimeter road unless it has its own pick). Automatic places a Two-Lane Road.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.localAsset.Tool: The road for cul-de-sacs and short local streets. Automatic uses the street road (a Two-Lane Road by default).
Placemaker.Roads.Control.localAsset.Desc: Dead ends and small side streets.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.avenueAsset.Too: The road for avenues and collectors, the main lines through the layout. Automatic places a Four-Lane Road.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.avenueAsset.Des: Wider main roads through the grid.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.roundaboutAsset: The one-way road that circles a roundabout island. Automatic places a Two-Lane One-Way Road: two lanes in the ring direction, like the Four-Lane avenue that feeds it. Only used when the layout has roundabouts (Radial, Mixed, Grid avenue crossings).
The one-way ring of a roundabout.
The loop around the edge of a drawn or painted area. Automatic uses the street road.
The road around the edge of the area.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.pathAsset.Toolt: Path used for the walkways and for the car-free streets inside superblocks. Automatic places a Pavement Path (dirt trails take a trail path when your playset has one).
Placemaker.Roads.Control.angle.Tooltip: Rotates the layout relative to the longest side of the area.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.alignTerrain.To: Turns the layout so one set of streets follows the slope's contour lines.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.gridMode.Toolti: Size blocks by distance, or by a number of columns and rows that fill the area.
Placemaker.Roads.Option.gridMode.count.T: A fixed number of columns and rows spread evenly over the area.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.gridColumns.Too: Number of streets across the area's length.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.gridRows.Toolti: Number of streets across the area's width.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.culDeSacs.Toolt: Turns some grid streets into dead ends with a turning circle.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.culDeSacFrequen: Share of blocks that get a cul-de-sac.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.culDeSacDepth.T: How far a cul-de-sac reaches into its block.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.culDeSacStagger: Alternates the side cul-de-sacs start from, block after block.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.capStyle.Toolti: Decoration placed at the end of every cul-de-sac.
Placemaker.Roads.Option.capStyle.grass.T: Turning circle with a grass island.
Placemaker.Roads.Option.capStyle.trees.T: Turning circle with trees in the middle.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.capSize.Tooltip: Size of the turning circle. Automatic matches the road width.
Placemaker.Roads.Option.capSize.xl.Toolt: Extra large turning circle (not available in asphalt).
Placemaker.Roads.Control.avenueColumn.To: Makes one column of the grid an avenue.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.avenueRow.Toolt: Makes one row of the grid an avenue.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.avenueIndex.Too: Which column or row becomes the avenue, counted from the first street.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.roundaboutIslan: Places a roundabout island where the avenue column and row meet.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.treeBranchSpaci: Distance between two branches on the same side of the collector.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.treeCulDeSacSpa: Distance between two pairs of cul-de-sacs along a branch.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.loops.Tooltip: Share of branches that join another street instead of ending in a cul-de-sac.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.variation.Toolt: Another random layout with the same settings.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.contourLinkSpac: Distance between roads that climb from one level street to the next.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.avenues.Tooltip: Number of straight avenues leaving the central roundabout.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.loopCollectorSp: Distance between collectors; each large block between them gets its own loop.
Size of each block inside a superblock.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.rings.Tooltip: Number of rings. Fewer are built when the area is too narrow for them.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.concentricConne: Number of streets linking the innermost ring outwards.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.roundaboutRadiu: Radius of the central roundabout (reduced to fit the area).
Placemaker.Roads.Control.perimeterRoad.T: A road around the edge of the area that the new streets connect to.
Placemaker.Roads.Option.perimeterRoad.au: On for drawn and painted areas; off for picked blocks, which are already surrounded by roads.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.perimeterCorner: Radius of the perimeter road at the corners of a drawn or painted area. Small keeps the road on your outline (never tighter than the road can turn); the winding styles use more.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.connectExisting: Joins new streets to the roads they meet or cross.
Leaves out streets that would cross water, buildings or power line pylons, without leaving dead-end stubs.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.followTerrain.T: Roads follow the ground. Off: the whole network stays at the area's average height.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.edgeDepth.Toolt: How deep the strips along the new streets reach into each block (used by zoning and other add-ons).
Placemaker.Roads.Control.streetTrees.Too: Trees along both sides of the streets.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.streetGrass.Too: Grass strips along the streets (not with wide sidewalks).
Placemaker.Roads.Control.streetBikeLanes: Bike lanes on both sides of the streets.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.avenueTrees.Too: Trees along both sides of the avenues.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.avenueGrass.Too: Grass strips along both sides of the avenues.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.avenueBikeLanes: Bike lanes on both sides of the avenues.
Placemaker.Roads.Issue.NothingFits: No streets fit in this area with these settings. Try a larger area or smaller spacing.
Placemaker.Roads.Issue.TerrainFlat: The terrain here is flat: the contour pattern has no slope to follow.
Placemaker.Roads.Issue.ObstaclesAvoided: {0} road segments were left out to avoid water and buildings.
Placemaker.Roads.Issue.GenerationFailed: The streets could not be planned: {0}
Placemaker.Roads.Issue.InvalidArea: The area outline is not valid.
Placemaker.Recipe.Roads.Description: A street pattern for the area, connected to the roads around it.
Placemaker.Recipe.RoadsWithParks.Descrip: Streets, with a park filling every block between them.
Placemaker.Recipe.RoadsWithZoning.Descri: Streets, with zoning painted along every new street.
Placemaker.EdgeZoning.Name: Edge zoning
Placemaker.Zone.Type.Tooltip: Which zone the plots get; buildings of that zone grow there.
Placemaker.Zone.commercialLow.Tooltip: Shops and small businesses (low density commercial).
Placemaker.Zone.commercialHigh.Tooltip: Department stores and shop towers (high density commercial).
Placemaker.Zone.mixed.Tooltip: Shops on the ground floor with flats above.
Placemaker.Zone.residentialMedium.Toolti: Apartment blocks of a few storeys.
Placemaker.EdgeZoning.Control.cutout.Too: Set by the Zoning feature: zone the whole cutout, however deep.
Placemaker.EdgeZoning.Control.zone.Toolt: A specific zone (mods included) instead of the zone type. Cells already zoned keep their zone.
Placemaker.EdgeZoning.Control.depth.Tool: How deep the zoning reaches from the road (8 m per cell, 6 cells at most).
Placemaker.EdgeZoning.Issue.NoFrontage: No road runs along this area, so nothing was zoned.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.junctionSpacing: On main roads (avenues): side streets join at most this often (m). Closer side streets end in a cul-de-sac before the avenue (with a footpath to it) or join their neighbours instead. 0 = every side street joins.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.walkways.Toolti: Footpaths that shorten walks: from cul-de-sacs to the next street or close, through long blocks and through the middle of grid blocks. 0 = none.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.walkwayStyle.To: Paved footpaths, dirt trails (a trail path when your playset has one, with worn ground painted along it), or a mix.
Placemaker.Roads.Option.walkwayStyle.tra: Dirt or gravel trails with worn ground painted along them (terrain paint is permanent).
Placemaker.Roads.Control.backLanes.Toolt: Small lanes through the middle of the blocks, between two parallel streets (share of the blocks that can take one). Never onto an avenue.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.laneStyle.Toolt: Paved alleys, gravel lanes, or a mix.
The Alley road (or the lane road you pick).
Placemaker.Roads.Control.laneAsset.Toolt: Road used for back lanes. Automatic places the Alley.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.tipStyle.Toolti: The road of the dead-end streets: the same as their street, gravel, or gravel at some of them.
Every cul-de-sac is a gravel road from its last junction.
Placemaker.Roads.Option.tipStyle.mixed.T: About half of the cul-de-sacs are gravel roads.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.terrainFit.Tool: Follow contours lays the streets along the slope (grids bend onto the contour lines, winding streets steer by the hill, too-steep links go). Ignore terrain keeps the pattern strict whatever the ground does.
Each pattern as it is (its own Align to terrain option).
Placemaker.Roads.Option.terrainFit.follo: Streets along the contour lines, gentle climbs between them.
Placemaker.Roads.Option.terrainFit.ignor: The strict pattern, straight over hills.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.landShape.Toolt: Terraced: on a hill every street's lots are levelled across the street, as deep as their zone cells, with a bank at the back of the lots up to the next level; the banks are painted and planted. Flat ground is never touched. Natural: the ground as it is.
Placemaker.Roads.Option.landShape.terrac: Level lots along every street, banks between the levels (sloped ground only).
Placemaker.Roads.Control.maxGrade.Toolti: The grade the layout aims to stay under (%). Steeper roads are marked in Design; Follow contours removes too-steep links where it can.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.preZone.Tooltip: Zones every cell along every new road with this zone once the roads are built. Cells you zoned before keep their zone.
Placemaker.Roads.Issue.IslandsDropped: {0} road pieces ({1} m) could not be linked to the rest and were left out.
Placemaker.Roads.Issue.NotConnected: These roads could not be linked to the nearby roads: connect them yourself after building.
Placemaker.Roads.Issue.Steep: A road here climbs {0} %, steeper than the steepest road set for this layout.
Placemaker.Roads.Option.pattern.terraces: Streets on the hill's contour lines, each on a level terrace as deep as its zone cells, with banks between and links up the slope.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.terraceCells.To: Zone cells (8 m each) kept level on each side of a terrace street.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.terraceLinks.To: How the roads between terraces climb.
Placemaker.Roads.Option.terraceLinks.dir: Straight up where gentle enough, else a long diagonal; switchbacks only where nothing else fits.
Placemaker.Roads.Option.terraceLinks.ser: Zig-zag legs joined by hairpin bends, climbing gently between two terraces.
Placemaker.Roads.Option.terraceLinks.spi: One road winding round and up the hill, crossing every terrace.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.terraceLinkSpac: How far apart the links up the hill are along a terrace street.
The links up the hill are avenues instead of streets.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.terraceFall.Too: A gentle cross-fall away from the bank so rain drains off (0 = dead level).
Placemaker.Roads.Control.terraceBank.Too: What stands between two levels: rounded grassy banks or steep straight faces.
Placemaker.Roads.Option.terraceBank.bank: A smooth S-shaped bank with rounded edges.
Placemaker.Roads.Option.terraceBank.wall: A straight steep face with crisp terrace edges, worn dirt on the face.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.terraceBankSlop: No bank between terraces is steeper than this (50 % = 1 in 2).
Placemaker.Roads.Control.terraceFlat.Too: Ground already flatter than this is never terraced.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.terraceEarthwor: The deepest cut or highest fill the terraces may make.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.terracePaint.To: Dry grass and worn dirt on the banks (terrain paint is permanent).
Placemaker.Roads.Control.terraceTrees.To: Clumps of trees on the banks between the terraces.
Placemaker.Roads.Issue.TerraceSteep: The hill is steeper than terraces this deep allow: they narrow in places. Fewer cells or a steeper bank fit better.
Placemaker.Roads.Issue.TerraceEarthwork: The earthwork is capped at {0} m: in places the terraces follow the hill a little.
Placemaker.Roads.Issue.TerraceFlat: The ground here is flat: the streets are laid in rows and nothing is terraced.
Placemaker.Roads.Issue.DroppedObstacle: Street left out: it would cross a building, water or a pylon and no way round fitted.
Placemaker.Roads.Issue.PerimeterBlocked: Perimeter piece left out: a building, water or a pylon sits on the outline and no way round fitted.
Placemaker.Roads.Issue.PerimeterOpen: The perimeter road does not close here: no clean way across the gap.
Placemaker.Roads.Issue.JunctionCut: Side street cut back from this main road: junctions here are kept this far apart.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.connectTo.Toolt: Which existing roads the new streets may join. Roads they may not join are never crossed either.
Placemaker.Roads.Option.connectTo.street: Every road except highways and their ramps.
Two-lane roads, lanes and gravel roads only: the big roads keep their junctions few.
Placemaker.Roads.Option.connectTo.any.To: Every road, highways and ramps too.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.gridCharacter.T: How perfect the grid stays. Strict: every street straight through, whatever the ground. Automatic: the grid gives way where the site asks (it bends on a hill, streets too steep for cars become steps, land too steep to build becomes a hillside park, a diagonal follows a desire line between two city streets when it is worth it). Lively: more of it, with staggered brick blocks and a square in the middle.
Placemaker.Roads.Option.gridCharacter.st: The plain grid: every street straight through.
Placemaker.Roads.Option.gridCharacter.au: The grid gives way to hills and desire lines, only where the site asks for it.
Placemaker.Roads.Option.gridCharacter.li: Staggered brick blocks, a square in the middle, a diagonal along a gentler desire line.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.roadWear.Toolti: Paints the ground the new streets wear in: worn desire paths where people take shortcuts, worn corners at the junctions, dry verges along the streets. Paint stays when the roads are removed.
A few desire paths, light wear.
